name: Maya Elbeth
source:
A girl Belial meets in the train on his way to the Saint Sheol temple. She's a fellow new rookie like him. Timid and unsure of herself, she doesn't react well to the harsh nature of her job. Maya often spends time in the flower garden, tending on flowers and plants.

Oddly enough, an angel bearing her face always appears in [url=https://vndb.org/c103282]Belial[/url]'s nightmares...
